rules.rule_text: Interpret a fixed-length window as a count of sampled rows and report the timestamp of its first row, not the timestamp of a salient transition occurring within the window.
Count the required rows from each candidate start and choose the earliest candidate whose complete forward window captures the approach lead-up or requested phase without starting after it has begun.
For each option, compute the explicitly specified statistic or aggregation before applying its threshold; do not substitute a related quantity.
Evaluate each option independently using its stated inequality and quantifier, then emit one T/F character per option in listed order.
